title: The driver app
note: Phone scenes take in/out from desktop/showcase/.work/driver-marks.json (scripts/record-driver.ps1). markText is a substring of the CAPTION marks printed by packages/driver_app/integration_test/demo_flow_test.dart.

scenes.title: The driver app
scenes.subtitle: Ravi's airport pickup, from his phone
scenes.narration: Drivers get their own Android app. Here is Ravi doing an airport pickup that the office assigned to him.

scenes.heading: Sign in with a code
scenes.sub: Phone number and a one-time code
scenes.narration: He signs in with his mobile number and a one-time code. On a new phone, the app asks once for the agency's code.

scenes.heading: Today's jobs
scenes.sub: Assigned trips, the moment he logs in
scenes.narration: Today's jobs are waiting for him.

scenes.heading: Every detail
scenes.sub: Pickup, flight notes, one-tap navigation and call
scenes.narration: Pickup point, flight notes, and one tap to navigate.

scenes.heading: Status, live
scenes.narration: Status updates go back to dispatch.

scenes.heading: Check in at pickup
scenes.narration: He checks in on arrival, with his location.

scenes.heading: Done
scenes.sub: Car and driver free for the next job
scenes.narration: Trip complete. Car and driver are free for the next job.

scenes.heading: In the driver's pocket
scenes.narration: His profile keeps his licence and documents, and his trip history. Hindi and Arabic translations are in the app, and the Android release build is ready for the store listing at launch.

scenes.headline: Dispatch to done, on one phone.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. From dispatch to done, on one phone.
